input: We have a MediaTek MT8188 board running Linux 6.11. The GPU keeps thermal throttling even at moderate workloads. The MT6358 PMIC AUXADC thermal readings look 15°C higher than an external thermocouple. Could the PMIC ADC calibration be wrong? How does the MT6358 AUXADC feed into the Linux thermal framework, and how can we verify the calibration?
